lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six horizontal rows and twelve visible vertical columns posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, forming a lattice of high-luminance nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, lower-luminance biological attachments (remoras) on the mid-lateral flank and near the ventral-pectoral transition.
